name: Production Stock Tracker
query:
SELECT 
    i.item_name,
    i.name AS item_code,
    i.stock_uom,

    COALESCE(SUM(sle_open.qty_after_transaction), 0) AS opening_balance,

    COALESCE((
        SELECT SUM(mdpi.qty)
        FROM `tabMaterial Demand Purchase Item` mdpi
        JOIN `tabMaterial Request Purchase` mdp ON mdpi.parent = mdp.name
        WHERE mdpi.item_code = i.name 
          AND mdp.transaction_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s 
          AND mdp.docstatus = 1
    ), 0) AS total_demanded_qty,

    COALESCE((
        SELECT SUM(poi.qty)
        FROM `tabPurchase Order Item` poi
        JOIN `tabPurchase Order` po ON poi.parent = po.name
        WHERE poi.item_code = i.name 
          AND po.docstatus = 1 
          AND po.transaction_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
    ), 0) AS total_ordered_qty,

    COALESCE((
        SELECT SUM(pri.qty)
        FROM `tabPurchase Receipt Item` pri
        JOIN `tabPurchase Receipt` pr ON pri.parent = pr.name
        WHERE pri.item_code = i.name 
          AND pr.docstatus = 1 
          AND pr.posting_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
    ), 0) AS total_received_qty,

    COALESCE(SUM(sle_close.qty_after_transaction), 0) AS closing_balance

FROM `tabItem` i

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT sle1.item_code, sle1.warehouse, sle1.qty_after_transaction
    FROM `tabStock Ledger Entry` sle1
    JOIN (
        SELECT item_code, warehouse, MAX(posting_date) AS max_date
        FROM `tabStock Ledger Entry`
        WHERE posting_date < %(from_date)s AND is_cancelled = 0
        GROUP BY item_code, warehouse
    ) AS t_open 
    ON sle1.item_code = t_open.item_code 
       AND sle1.warehouse = t_open.warehouse 
       AND sle1.posting_date = t_open.max_date
    WHERE sle1.is_cancelled = 0
) AS sle_open ON sle_open.item_code = i.name

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT sle2.item_code, sle2.warehouse, sle2.qty_after_transaction
    FROM `tabStock Ledger Entry` sle2
    JOIN (
        SELECT item_code, warehouse, MAX(posting_date) AS max_date
        FROM `tabStock Ledger Entry`
        WHERE posting_date <= %(to_date)s AND is_cancelled = 0
        GROUP BY item_code, warehouse
    ) AS t_close 
    ON sle2.item_code = t_close.item_code 
       AND sle2.warehouse = t_close.warehouse 
       AND sle2.posting_date = t_close.max_date
    WHERE sle2.is_cancelled = 0
) AS sle_close ON sle_close.item_code = i.name

WHERE i.name IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT mdpi.item_code
    FROM `tabMaterial Demand Purchase Item` mdpi
    JOIN `tabMaterial Request Purchase` mdp ON mdpi.parent = mdp.name
    WHERE mdp.transaction_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
)
GROUP BY i.item_name, i.name, i.stock_uom
ORDER BY i.item_name;
